title: Origins in Travel: Arriving from Stations and Airports

sections.content:
When talking about travel in Hungary:
- Transportation hubs with *tér* (square) take **-ről**: *repülőtér → repülőtérről* (from the airport), *vasútállomás → vasútállomásról* (from the railway station).
- Neighborhoods and city centers take **-ból/-ből**: *a belvárosból* (from the city center / downtown).

items.spanish: A repülőtérről busszal jövök a belvárosba.
items.english: I am coming by bus from the airport to the city center.
We just arrived from the railway station.
